source.description: One Wikimedia Commons photo per breed (the Wikidata P18 image of breeds.json) with its author, licence and file page, read from the Commons API.
notes: Only CC0, public domain, CC BY and CC BY-SA files are kept; rejected files are listed in data/reports/images.md.
The file is the Wikidata P18 image of breeds.json unless data/manual/photos.json picks another (chosenBy).
author is the plain text of the extmetadata Attribution field, else Artist, unless data/manual/photos.json gives a credit read from the file page (authorFrom).
Thumbnails (640 px requested) are downloaded unmodified to static/photos/ and served by the site; sourceUrl is the Wikimedia URL without utm_* parameters.
